name: esat-atlas
description: ESAT Atlas - static Cambridge Engineering admissions-test practice platform with Firebase authentication.

scripts.build:bank: node scripts/run_python.mjs scripts/build_question_bank.py && node scripts/run_python.mjs scripts/build_extended_bank.py && node scripts/run_python.mjs scripts/reclassify_topics.py
scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test tests/core.test.ts tests/scoring.test.ts tests/math-markup.test.ts tests/math-render.test.ts tests/original-mocks.test.ts tests/study-plan.test.ts tests/learning-guides.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run validate:bank && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run test:build
